recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male figure with long hair, seated in a relaxed pose against a dark, textured background. The composition uses a strong right-aligned typographic block with weathered, heavy-weight lettering and thin intersecting lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds while text anchors the upper right quadrant
Warm sepia and brown tones in the clothing harmonize with the golden-yellow text
The distressed texture of the font mimics the tactile quality of the velvet jacket
Thin horizontal and vertical lines create a geometric frame for the secondary text
coreInvariants: Warm, low-key lighting with soft highlights on the face and hair
Heavy-weight, all-caps display typography with visible erosion
A dark, vignetted background that transitions from deep brown to black

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male figure is positioned off-center to the left, scaled from the waist up, leaning slightly into the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed name block in the top right corner acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the shoulder to the text block, and then moves down to the secondary title line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the image is dominated by dark negative space, providing a high-contrast canvas for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal provide the base for the background and clothing shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and tan tones highlight the subject's hair and jacket lapels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-yellow with a weathered texture is used for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a focus on value contrast between the dark background and the illuminated subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallic golds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif with geometric proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Square terminals with slightly rounded corners from weathering
Internal erosion and 'grunge' textures applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg

composition.relationshipToImage: underlined by a thin graphic rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, distressed display face paired with a clean, widely-spaced secondary sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Thin intersecting lines (crosshair style) framing the text block
Subtle horizontal rule separating the artist name from the title

preserve: Distressed texture within the main font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary text.
Provides the correct skeleton for the display text before distressing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a long-haired man in a brown velvet jacket and black shirt, seated against a dark, textured brown wall. Use warm, low-key lighting. Ensure the right side of the frame is dark and relatively empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a heavy, distressed, golden-yellow sans-serif font, right-aligned in the top right. Add a secondary title below it in a clean, white, widely-spaced sans-serif, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Does the main font have a weathered, eroded texture?
Is the lighting warm and sepia-toned?
Are there thin graphic lines framing the text?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the typography
Subject's specific attire (e.g., leather vs velvet)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the clothing and font
Balanced asymmetry between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the distressed texture looks organic, not repetitive
Verify the hierarchy between the large name and smaller title
Confirm the background remains dark enough for text legibility
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject on left + dark textured negative space on right + right-aligned distressed display type + thin geometric line accents.
